Class Serial

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.usb.Serial
public final class Serial extends Object

      public static void begin(int baudRate)
      Starts serial communication at a custom data rate. Prefer begin(BaudRate) when the rate is represented by BaudRate.
      Parameters:
      baudRate - the data rate in bits per second

    • print

      public static void print(String message)
      Prints a compile-time string literal without a trailing line ending. Juno has no heap for a runtime string value.
      Parameters:
      message - the compile-time string literal to print

    • println

      public static void println(String message)
      Prints a compile-time string literal followed by a line ending. Juno has no heap for a runtime string value.
      Parameters:
      message - the compile-time string literal to print
